description: Rotate nodes. The optional range is applied to nodes, and they are rotated via the right-hand rule about a specified axis that passes through a specified point. If the set keyword is not given, then the current set is used.

description.6.0: Axis of rotation about which to rotate following the right-hand rule.
description.7.0: Axis of rotation about which to rotate following the right-hand rule.
description.9.0: Axis of rotation about which to rotate following the right-hand rule. In FLAC2D , rotation is always done counter-clockwise.
